{{en-adj}}

# Of or pertaining to [[demography]].
#* {{RQ:Atlantic|url=https://www.theatlantic.com/international/archive/2011/02/how-to-solve-chinas-gender-imbalance-the-babe-tax/71440/|title=How to Solve China's Gender Imbalance? The 'Babe Tax'|date=2011-02-18|author=James Fallows|passage=Yet it does bring up a much more real problem about China's '''demographic''' transition, which has led some to argue that China will "get old before it gets rich."|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110223113511/https://www.theatlantic.com/international/archive/2011/02/how-to-solve-chinas-gender-imbalance-the-babe-tax/71440/}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|chiefly|in plural}} A demographic [[criterion]]: a [[characteristic]] used to classify people for [[statistics|statistical]] purposes, such as [[age]], [[race]], or [[gender]].
#* '''1985,''' Richard I. Henderson, ''Compensation Management: Rewarding Performance'', Fourth Edition,<sup>[http://books.google.com/books?id=3AVHAAAAMAAJ]</sup> Reston Pub. Co., {{ISBN|0835909743}}, page 604,
#* '''2000,''' James Chapman, “Impact of Building Roads to Everywhere”, in Robert D. Bullard, Glenn S. Johnson, and Angel O. Torres (eds.), ''Sprawl City: Race, Politics, and Planning in Atlanta'',<sup>[http://books.google.com/books?id=Arg-DU8tQF8C]</sup> Island Press, {{ISBN|1-55963-790-0}}, page 82,
# A demographic [[group]]: a collection of people sharing a value for a certain demographic criterion.
#: {{syn|en|demo|q1=informal}}
#* '''2002,''' Laura Grindstaff, ‘Pretty Woman with a Gun: ''[[w:La Femme Nikita|La Femme Nikita]]'' and the Textual Politics of “The Remake”’, in Jennifer Forrest and Leonard R. Koos (eds.), ''Dead Ringers: The Remake in Theory and Practice'',<sup>[http://books.google.com/books?id=R1CRyD4Bs44C]</sup> State University of New York Press, {{ISBN|0-7914-5169-0}}, page 281,
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Tom Hutchison; Amy Macy; Paul Allen|title=Record Label Marketing|page=189|publisher=Elsevier
|passage=A newspaper is consumed by many '''demographics''', a small portion of which may be the target.}}
#* '''2006,''' Kelley Keehn, ''The Woman's Guide to Money'',<sup>[http://books.google.com/books?id=cgRSZWh0BdkC]</sup> Insomniac Press, {{ISBN|1897178085}}, page 44,
#*: As a member of the Generation X '''demographic''', I'm saddened to admit that paying with plastic (whether debit or credit card) has superseded paying with real money.
#*: "The '''demographic''' for NASCAR is people who eat," said Steve Page, president of the former Infineon Raceway{{...}}. "We're giving people plenty to do before the race."
# An individual person's characteristic, encoded for the purposes of statistical analysis.
#: {{rfquote-sense|en}}
